# betteredge_project (Resource)

A project on the BetterEdge platform. TEDs are created inside a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betteredge_project" "example" {
  name        = "example-project"
  description = "Created by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project. Must be 4-32 characters long.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description for the project. If omitted, the current description is kept (empty for a new project); set it to `""` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import betteredge_project.example cc8882e2-baf0-4493-aec6-15f79fc5eb6b
```
